title: Central limit theorem for slow-fast system under mixed fractional Brownian motion
summary: This work considers a type of slow-fast system, where the slow component is driven by fractional Brownian motion (FBM) with \(H > 1/2\) and the fast component is a Markovian stationary process. Our solution mapping is defined based on the Young-Wiener sense, which is constructed via the stochastic sewing lemma. Then, we aim to show the fluctuation from the averaging limit by applying the Poisson PDE method.
